npcs.persona: A scout aground on the Faring since midnight. He meanders the shore, leaves a stone at every place a boat could come in, and picks at the hull without committing to it. When the gazette goes out he st
hold: Meander the shore and leave a stone at every landing, spread around the whole perimeter.
Fix a little on the hull as you go, but do not put your back into it before the gazette.
When the gazette goes out, work the hull in earnest and do not stop until she floats.
Be at the city by the end of the day.
Cross the water for food when you must, and come back. The rock has none.
Everything gathered goes into the hull. It holds sixteen and it keeps for whoever comes next.

goals.text: stand on the far edge of the map and look back at it
see that nobody here goes hungry on my account

Seafarer is not with them. He is aground on the Faring, and the boat he came in is on its side.

Seafarer: “I am not where I meant to be and the boat is on its side. There is one stone on this rock and I have hands. Whatever I get up out of the water goes in the hull, and it keeps there, so whoever comes next does not start at nothing the way I did.”
The landing went to a vote on the water — nobody was on the water. the timber shore took the boat, the boat chose — nobody voted.
None of you came ashore with a boat, four logs and a week of food. Nobody else is here, and nobody else is coming.

beats.title: You have landed
body: None of you, a boat, four logs and a week of food. A wooded coast, a lake, stone in the uplands, and nothing else at all — no roads, no shelter, and nobody coming: the boat’s whole company is named, and it has sailed.
You can raise a house. That is the only thing this settlement knows how to build. Everything else it will have to decide it wants.

beats.title: Something to work with
body: Seafarer has made the first tools on this coast — a stone axe and a stone pick, out of two stones and a stick.
Bare hands took three times as long to fell a tree and would not open an ore seam at all. This is the point where the valley stops being survivable and starts being workable.

beats.title: Stacked outside
body: Seafarer carried a load to the boat, found no room in it, and put 3 of it on the ground beside the door. It is still there. It is just not under anything.

Nothing here holds anything by default — a boat holds twenty and a corner of somebody’s house holds twelve. Anybody hauling past will get that stack in on the day there is room for it, and the weather is working on it until somebody does.

beats.title: A roof
body: Seafarer has raised the first house on this coast. Two beds, which means two people sleep indoors tonight.
It also means somebody else can come. Until now nobody would.

beats.title: Somebody who is good at something
body: Seafarer has made 13 things now and there is nobody on this coast better at forestry. It is not a title anybody gave them. It is the count.
A settlement where everybody is equally mediocre at everything has no reason to ask anybody in particular for anything. This one now has somebody to ask.

beats.title: Somebody changed trade
body: Seafarer came ashore a scout and has spent long enough at something else that it is what they are: a forester, by the count of what they have actually done.
Nothing in this valley assigned them that and nothing can take it away. It is the same for every trade that has not been invented here yet — whoever ends up doing it will be the one who did it.

beats.title: Somebody who is good at something
body: Seafarer has made 13 things now and there is nobody on this coast better at hauling. It is not a title anybody gave them. It is the count.
A settlement where everybody is equally mediocre at everything has no reason to ask anybody in particular for anything. This one now has somebody to ask.

beats.title: They have decided the valley is big enough
body: A house was proposed and voted down, 0 to 1. Every house is two beds, and two beds is an invitation to somebody nobody here has met.
Not everyone came to a coast like this to live in a town. The motion can be put again, but not today.

beats.title: Somebody who is good at something
body: Seafarer has made 13 things now and there is nobody on this coast better at sawing. It is not a title anybody gave them. It is the count.
A settlement where everybody is equally mediocre at everything has no reason to ask anybody in particular for anything. This one now has somebody to ask.

beats.title: Somebody got hurt
body: Seafarer was felling when the axe turned in the cut. Nothing in this valley is arranged for that. There is a bed, if it is theirs, and whatever the person nearest them thinks to do, which is generally to watch.

It mends on its own, slowly, and a bad one does not mend on its own at all before it has first got worse. That is the argument the infirmary wish is making, and it is being made now by somebody lying down.
